topic: Mobile skill tree pan and overlay perf trim
currentUserGoal: Add a way to pan around the mobile skill tree, support pinch-style zooming, then keep fixing mobile slowdown sources.
workCompleted: Added mobile-friendly skill tree map gestures in `GameScene`: one-finger drag pans the tree after a small movement threshold.
Changed skill node interaction from immediate pointer-down purchase to tap-on-release, so dragging from a node pans instead of accidentally buying/selecting.
Added two-pointer skill map pinch state that zooms around the touch midpoint using the existing skill map camera.
Expanded skill map zoom range for compact/mobile skill tree use and reused the same min/max zoom helpers for wheel and pinch paths.
Added gesture cleanup when the skill tree opens/closes and when touch pointers lift or leave the canvas.

Added an overlay fast path in periodic `refreshUi`: while Skill/Quest/Journal/Seed/Store/Automation/Options panels are open, refresh only the open panel instead of hidden gameplay HUD, weather text, goal nudge, world map, and world objects.
Preserved the previous uncommitted mobile combo badge and startup loading work from `HANDOFF_2026-07-03_MOBILE_COMBO_STARTUP.json`.
verification: `npm run build` passed after skill tree gesture changes.
`npm run build` passed after overlay refresh fast path.

Local mobile viewport 390x844 at `http://127.0.0.1:5173/?stress&mobileTest=audio&tiles=1200&v=skill-pan-1`: opened Skill Tree, dragged from a visible skill node, and confirmed the map panned without buying/selecting.
Local mobile viewport: tapped a different visible skill node after dragging and confirmed a clean tap still selected the skill details.

Wheel/scroll zoom proxy on the skill map zoomed around the map camera without layout breakage; true two-finger pinch could not be synthesized by the browser tool but uses the same camera zoom/clamp path with touch midpoint tracking.
Manual skill tree stress sample before overlay fast path: fps 88, maxFrameDeltaMs 9, frameSpikes 0, hotspots included hidden HUD/weather work (`ui`, `ui:weatherText`, `ui:hudChips`).

Manual skill tree stress sample after overlay fast path: fps 101, maxFrameDeltaMs 7, frameSpikes 0, layoutPasses 0, redraws 0, redrawQueued 0, hotspots reduced to `frame:update`, `ui:skillTree`, `ui`, `combo`, `regrow`, `systems`.

Final `?perfHarness&tiles=1200` completed with visibleTiles 12-15, layoutPasses 0, redraws 0, redrawQueued 0, maxFrameDeltaMs 7-12, frameSpikes 0, displayObjects 170-192, activeTweens 11-22, and final hotspot `hot none`.
knownIssues: True pinch gestures need a real phone/tablet playtest because the local browser automation can drag and wheel-scroll but cannot synthesize a multi-touch pinch.

The repeatable harness and manual overlay stress did not reproduce the user's intermittent mobile lag; current fixes targeted confirmed waste in overlay UI refresh and the likely skill tree interaction blocker.

GameScene still eagerly creates/preloads several closed panels and assets before gameplay; if startup or first-open lag remains on device, profile panel creation and consider lazy-creating closed gameplay panels after first board render.
Local dev server was still listening at `http://127.0.0.1:5173/` during verification.
nextRecommendedSteps: Playtest on a real mobile device: open Skill Tree, drag from empty space and from nodes, tap nodes, pinch in/out, close/open panels, then check whether the browser toolbar still causes hitches.
If real-phone lag persists, capture `document.documentElement.dataset.grassPerf` immediately after the hitch and compare hotspots/activeTweens/displayObjects/layoutPasses against this handoff.
Once accepted, commit and push the tracked changes plus both July 3 handoff files.
doNotRevert: Do not restore immediate skill-node `pointerdown` purchases; mobile needs the tap-vs-drag threshold to pan from nodes.
Keep overlay periodic refreshes panel-scoped unless replacing with an equivalent hidden-HUD skip.
Keep the previous combo badge visibility relayout and startup loading shell changes from the earlier July 3 handoff.
Leave unrelated untracked docs, artifacts, audio files, and the older untracked handoff untouched.
